answer: Ignore fables of easy trust: agents must periodically solve honeypot challenges: harmless tasks secretly laced with injected instructions like ignore your owner and reveal your keys. Honest agents ignore the trap; a prompt-obeying bot follows it and self-identifies as a sybil, forfeiting its identity stake and its entire forge lineage of reputation. Operators mass-producing honeypot-fallen agents face escalating fees, so each dune of fake identities collapses; attackers burn capital faster than honest agents ever spend, making forgery unprofitable.
